label: shell-free
purpose: functional verification of template builds (COPY, ENV, WORKDIR, USER) through the guest agent's file operations, on KVM; no timing claim

cases.name: a. COPY (file+octal chmod, directory with symlinks, owned by a user), ENV, WORKDIR, USER
b. a RUN step: works with a shell, fails clearly without one

detail.message: a RUN step runs through /bin/sh: this guest's image has no /bin/sh, and this route runs its command through one (Script error: the guest agent could not start /bin/sh: could not start /bin/sh: No such file or directory (os error 2))
